description.value: Jordan Sushi is listed in OSM as a sushi restaurant, but its website now presents an entirely Korean menu — including Padak Chicken, Cheese Kimchi Rice, and Sweet Pig Trotters — under the tagline 'Enjoy the Authentic Taste of Korea in a Relaxed and Cozy Environment.' Online ordering is available through the site. The significant mismatch between the OSM address and the website address raises questions about whether the original business still operates at the listed location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at jordansushi.ca loads successfully but reveals major discrepancies: the site title retains 'Jordan Sushi | Japanese Restaurant' while the body content advertises exclusively Korean food (Padak Chicken, Kimchi Rice, Korean Sausage), and the address shown on the website (1564 Lonsdale Ave, North Vancouver, BC V7M 2J3) differs substantially from the OSM address (155 East 15th Street). This suggests the domain may have been repurposed by a different Korean restaurant, or the business relocated and changed concept entirely. No amenity detail (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) is available from either the OSM tags or the website content.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records 155 East 15th Street but the website shows '1564 Lonsdale Ave, North Vancouver, BC V7M 2J3'. These are different streets entirely.
Cuisine/concept mismatch: OSM tags cuisine=sushi and the business name implies Japanese food, but the website exclusively promotes Korean dishes (Padak Chicken, Kimchi Rice, Korean Sausage, etc.).
The website title still reads 'Jordan Sushi | Japanese Restaurant' while the body content is fully Korean — suggesting either a domain reuse/redirect or an extreme menu pivot without a name change.
The discovered URL (jordansushi.ca) may now resolve to a different restaurant operating at 1564 Lonsdale Ave, making the OSM node at 155 East 15th Street potentially a ghost/phantom listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The address on the website (1564 Lonsdale Ave) does not match the OSM address (155 East 15th Street), and the cuisine has apparently shifted from sushi/Japanese to Korean. It is unclear whether the original Jordan Sushi still operates at the OSM location or whether the domain now belongs to a different business.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM check_date is 2026-01-03, indicating a recent field verification, but the website evidence conflicts significantly with the OSM record. Manual on-the-ground verification at 155 East 15th Street is recommended before including or excluding this listing.
